mechanism_narrative: The federal funds rate at 0.13% is at a historically low level, indicating an extremely accommodative monetary policy that reduces the discount rate for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS is at or below 0.15% (as of t-1mo), or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A CPI reading above 230.0 (current value 230.102) indicates persistent inflation, which triggers a market reaction of positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate central bank tightening that will eventually lead to a more stable inflation environment.
failure_condition: When CPIAUCSL exceeds 230.0, the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of cases, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of high unemployment rate (UNRATE > 7.5%) and declining labor force participation (PAYEMS < 133000.0) signals a weakening labor market, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as the market anticipates a recession.
failure_condition: When UNRATE > 7.5% and PAYEMS < 133000.0, the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion, a decline in housing starts (HOUST < 750.0) signals an impending slowdown in the housing market, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the market prices in a potential recession.
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansion, when HOUST < 750.0, the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of cases, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO < 97.0) signals a contraction in the supply side of the economy, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as the market reacts to the immediate supply shock.
failure_condition: When INDPRO < 97.0, the 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of cases, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: The current unemployment rate of 8.1% is above the historical average, indicating a weak labor market that leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as the market prices in a potential recession.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE is above 7.5% (as of t-1mo), or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST < 750.0) and retail sales (RSAFS < 407000.0) signals a weakening demand in the housing and retail sectors, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When HOUST < 750.0 and RSAFS < 407000.0, the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle (as indicated by rising CPI), a CPI reading above 230.0 leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as the market prices in the risk of further rate hikes.
failure_condition: In a monetary tightening cycle, when CPIAUCSL > 230.0, the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of cases, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
